snippet.title: Loftia - Official Gameplay Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Loftia, a cozy multiplayer life simulation game developed by Qloud Games. Players will meet up with friends in a shared world to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and more across a vibrant world. Loftia is coming soon to PC (Steam).
